_comment: Published single-dose (70 kg healthy adult, oral IR) and steady-state reference values used to validate the presets (core/validation.py, tests/test_reference_pk.py). Units match data/drugs.json concentration units (mg/L = ug/mL; AUC in unit*h). max_fold is the allowed symmetric fold error (default 1.5). verified=true: the value was checked against the primary document named in source - an SPC or regulator label, the original study's full text (or its abstract, where the note says 'abstract only'), or a registry's posted results - and the note says where. verified=false: no primary could be reached, primaries disagree, or a field is calibrated rather than observed; the note says which. Drug-information aggregators and label mirrors are never a source for a verified value (tests/test_data_provenance.py). Entries marked 'Known limitation' document where a one-compartment model cannot match the data.

references.note: Brufen 400 mg tablet arm, fasted, n=36, geometric mean (NCT01879371 posted results: 31.1 ug/mL; 31.0 is the ibuprofen+caffeine arm). Schettler 2008 (PMC2613135) arithmetic means 30.9 and 32.9.

Primary documents disagree. Schettler 2008 (400 mg fasted, full text Table 2): median tmax 1.50 h (Nurofen forte) and 1.75 h (Migränin); US Rx ibuprofen label 'one to two hours'; Swedish MPA Brufen PAR '1-3 hours'; Czech SPC (Ibalgin) 'nalačno dosahuje již za 45 minut'. Kept at the measured 400 mg value.

Al-Tamimi 2025 (Int J App Pharm 17(5):315), 400 mg IR tablet, fasted, n=28, arithmetic mean AUC0-inf 107.8 ug*h/mL. Caveat: an unregistered test formulation. Other primaries at 400 mg: NCT01879371 Brufen arm 127 (geometric mean), Schettler 2008 115-117. The previously cited TGA PI is for IV Caldolor.

Sevilla-Tirado 2003 (Methods Find Exp Clin Pharmacol 25:531), 1000 mg single oral dose, n=12, abstract only (full text unreachable); midpoint of the five formulations' means, which include effervescent and sachet forms: Cmax 17.98-20.73 ug/mL. Two-compartment model (V1 21 % of Vss, Q 77.5 L/h, Owens 2014). No absorption lag: measured curves show paracetamol in plasma from 5 minutes.

Sevilla-Tirado 2003 (Methods Find Exp Clin Pharmacol 25:531), 1000 mg single oral dose, n=12, abstract only (full text unreachable); midpoint of the five formulations' means, which include effervescent and sachet forms: tmax 0.40-0.88 h; conventional Panadol tablet 0.88 h. Paralen SPC: 30-60 min.

Sevilla-Tirado 2003 (Methods Find Exp Clin Pharmacol 25:531), 1000 mg single oral dose, n=12, abstract only (full text unreachable); midpoint of the five formulations' means, which include effervescent and sachet forms: AUC0-inf 52.6-56.3 ug*h/mL.
US AMOXIL label 12.3: average peak 5.5-7.5 mcg/mL after 500 mg capsules (midpoint). Czech SPC: 3.3 ug/mL at 250 mg, linear to 3000 mg. Eshelman 1978 (abstract) reports 8.9 fasting.
US AMOXIL label 12.3: peak 1 to 2 hours after 250 and 500 mg capsules (midpoint). Czech SPC table: median 1.5 h (1.0-2.0) at 250 mg fasted; its general text says about 1 h.

pms-Lithium monograph Table 2: single 300 mg IR capsule, fasted, healthy volunteers, AUC0-inf 4.97 mmol*h/L (geometric mean). Replaces cavg_ss 0.85 at 300 mg q8h, which was the midpoint of the Lithobid (extended-release) maintenance target 0.6-1.2 mmol/L, not a measurement.

pms-Lithium monograph Table 2: single 300 mg IR capsule, FASTED, Cmax 0.40 mmol/L. The previous 0.28 was the fed-state value (Table 1). APO monograph fasting 2x300 mg gives 0.31 per 300 mg, so between-study spread is large.
pms-Lithium monograph Table 2: single 300 mg IR capsule, fasted, Tmax 1.21 h (arithmetic mean). The monographs' narrative says 'two to four hours'; the Czech SPC 1-2 h; APO fasting 600 mg 2.05 h.
US Valium label and Czech SPC: mean fasted tmax 1.25 h (range 0.25-2.5 h). Hogan 2020 (10 mg Valium, fasted): geometric mean 0.81-1.0 h.

Hogan 2020 (Epilepsia 61:455) Table 2: Valium 10 mg after a 10 h fast, healthy adults 51-75 kg, n=17, AUC0-inf geometric mean 8268 h*ng/mL (76-111 kg: 7850). Replaces 5.8, which applied F to an oral clearance (10 mg / 26.6 mL/min is 6.27 without it). Other primaries: Gough 1982 5.06 (n=7), Caraco 1995 4.85 (CYP2C19 EMs).

NCT01890785 posted results: d-amphetamine Cmax 61.0 ng/mL (arithmetic mean) after a 70 mg intact capsule, fasted, 30 healthy adults. Replaces 0.0446 at 50 mg, cited to Ermer 2010 (full text unreachable) through a 2013 paper that only restates it; 61.0 x 50/70 = 43.6 agrees.
US Vyvanse label and Czech SPC: d-amphetamine Tmax 3.8 h after a 70 mg capsule, fasted (FDA review NRP104.102: 3.78 h, n=18, arithmetic mean; median 4.0 h).

NCT01890785 posted results: d-amphetamine AUC (0-96 h) 1180.2 ng*h/mL after a 70 mg intact capsule, fasted, 30 healthy adults. Replaces 0.959, scaled from 1342 (NRP104.106, a 14C oral solution in 6 subjects). FDA review NRP104.102 capsule: 1110 (n=18).
Zhao 2007 Table 1: 500 mg, fasted, 26 healthy Chinese men (64 kg), arithmetic mean. 1000 mg: 31.5 (NCT00859521). One-compartment model underestimates the early peak.

Primary documents disagree. US Keppra label: 'approximately 1 hour' in fasted subjects; EU SmPC and Czech SPC: 1.3 h (EPAR: 1.3 +/- 0.7 h pooled over 250-5000 mg, fed state not stated); Zhao 2007 at 500 mg fasted: median 0.5 h.
Zhao 2007 Table 1: 500 mg, fasted, n=26, arithmetic mean AUC0-inf. The paper's Chinese/White ratio is 0.92, so a 70 kg White adult would be higher.
Tjandrawinata 2015, Lyrica reference arm, 150 mg fasted, n=20, arithmetic mean. One-compartment model underestimates the early peak.
Tjandrawinata 2015, Lyrica reference arm, median tmax. Czech SPC: 1 h fasted.
Tjandrawinata 2015, Lyrica reference arm, arithmetic mean AUC0-inf.
Salehifar 2017, single 40 mg tablet, fasted, 20 healthy Iranian adults (10 M/10 F); Cmax CV about 34 %. Caveat: Table 2 values come from a fitted two-compartment model.
Salehifar 2017, mean of the sex groups (105 and 96 min). Model-estimated: the sampling grid cannot observe 90-105 min. US label: 1 to 4 hours.
Ismail 2004, 2 x 40 mg Inderal, 18 healthy Malaysian men (64 kg), fasted, arithmetic mean (CV 66 %). Two subjects exceeded the assay's calibrated range.
Ismail 2004, Inderal arm, AUC0-inf arithmetic mean (CV 51 %).
Genis-Najera 2024 (Neurol Ther 13:141) Table 3: Roche 2 mg tablet, fasting, n=29, arithmetic mean 13.23 ng/mL.
Genis-Najera 2024 Table 3: Roche 2 mg tablet, arithmetic mean Tmax 3.33 h (the abstract's '3 h' pools both arms). Czech SPC: 1-4 h.
Genis-Najera 2024 Table 3: Roche 2 mg, AUC0-inf arithmetic mean 540.88 ng*h/mL. Also F*D/CL from the Czech SPC (F 0.9, CL 55 mL/min) = 0.545.

Nierychlewski 2025 (Eur J Clin Pharmacol 81:1677) Table 1: median steady-state TROUGH serum level 36.8 ng/mL (IQR 25.0-52.5), n=328 patients, median dose 30 mg (15-45 mg), drawn 'prior to the first daily dose'; includes 56 on interacting co-medication. Metric corrected from cavg_ss: these are troughs. The dosing time is not stated; the SPC advises evening dosing, so samples may be 10-12 h post-dose.

Midpoint of two values, neither confirmable: Zheng 2012 (abstract) AUC0-inf 627 ng*h/mL is the TEST formulation (reference 631.5) and the abstract gives no dose; the 'Thai study 679' is uncited and was not found. Full text paywalled.
0.0587 is Zheng 2012's TEST-formulation Cmax 58.7 ng/mL (reference 58.3); the abstract gives no dose. Fast distribution phase; captured by the two-compartment preset (distribution parameters fitted).

Health Canada Risperdal monograph Table 1.9: single 1 mg oral dose, young healthy subjects (n=8, median), risperidone + 9-hydroxyrisperidone AUC0-inf 132 ng*h/mL (Cmax 9.1 ng/mL, t1/2 17 h). Replaces cavg_ss 0.028 at 2 mg q12h, derived from a patient TDM norm (C/D 'around 7') stated in passing by a review of long-acting injectables. Inter-individual spread about 20-fold, not explained by CYP2D6.
Ritalin reference arm of the pms-Methylphenidate monograph: 2 x 10 mg, fasted men, n=26, geometric mean.
Ritalin reference arm, 2 x 10 mg, fasted men, n=26, geometric mean AUC0-inf. The Czech SPC's oral clearance of about 10 L/h/kg would imply about half this, from different studies.
Ritalin reference arm, 2 x 10 mg, fasted men, n=26, arithmetic mean Tmax 1.80 h. The previous 1.75 averaged the test (1.70) and reference arms.

de la Torre 2000 (Br J Clin Pharmacol 49:104) Table 1: single oral dose, 8 healthy male CYP2D6 extensive metabolisers, arithmetic mean; salt form not stated. 75 mg Cmax 130.9 ug/L (also Mas 1999). The previous 0.126 came from a secondary restatement.

de la Torre 2000 (Br J Clin Pharmacol 49:104) Table 1: single oral dose, 8 healthy male CYP2D6 extensive metabolisers, arithmetic mean; salt form not stated. 75 mg AUC0-24 1331.5 ug*h/L. AUC rises more than dose-proportionally (saturation or inhibition of metabolism).

de la Torre 2000b (Ann N Y Acad Sci 914:225) Table 3: 100 mg, n=8, arithmetic mean Cmax 222.5 ng/mL (also de la Torre 2004; Hernandez-Lopez 2002: 231.4, n=9). A different subject set from the 75/125 mg study. The previous 0.19 was one of two pilot subjects (189.9 and 209.7).
de la Torre 2000b Table 3: 100 mg, n=8, AUC0-24 2431.4 ng*h/mL (Hernandez-Lopez 2002: 2447.9). The previous 2.057 matched neither pilot subject. Farré 2004 first dose: 1452 (n=9).

de la Torre 2000 (Br J Clin Pharmacol 49:104) Table 1: single oral dose, 8 healthy male CYP2D6 extensive metabolisers, arithmetic mean; salt form not stated. 125 mg Cmax 236.4 ug/L (also Mas 1999). The previous 0.229 came from Peiró 2013's restatement.
de la Torre 2000 (Br J Clin Pharmacol 49:104) Table 1: single oral dose, 8 healthy male CYP2D6 extensive metabolisers, arithmetic mean; salt form not stated. 125 mg AUC0-24 2623.7 ug*h/L.
Kubota 2013 (J Curr Surg 3:82) Table 1, racemic ketamine 50 mg oral solution, n=6 Japanese adults (61.5 kg), dosed AFTER A MEAL; values from a fitted curve. Oral F 17-24 % elsewhere.
Kubota 2013 (J Curr Surg 3:82) Table 1, racemic ketamine 50 mg oral solution, n=6 Japanese adults (61.5 kg), dosed AFTER A MEAL; values from a fitted curve.

Farré 2015, 2 x 100 mg 4 h apart, fasted, n=10: AUC +17.1 % above simple accumulation, but computed over 4-12 h after the first dose (Table 2), while this metric integrates 0-24 h. Not the same quantity; no 0-24 h value is reported.
Farré 2015, 2 x 100 mg 4 h apart, fasted, n=10: MDMA Cmax +23.1 % above simple accumulation. Both peaks follow the second dose, so the 4-12 h window does not change it.
Farré 2004 Table 2, 2 x 100 mg 24 h apart, n=9: AUC24-48/AUC0-24 1.77 from observed concentrations (includes the first dose's residual; 1.39 after subtracting it). CYP2D6 still inactivated.
Farré 2004 Table 2, 2 x 100 mg 24 h apart, n=9: Cmax 232 vs 180 ng/mL (x1.29).
